name: Kenji
self_text: I'm an American in my mid 30s who spends a lot of my spare time looking at the stars with my telescope. When I'm not doing amateur astronomy, I'm usually on my handheld playing Skyforge Arena. I typically queue for casual matches. I am looking for someone to coach me. I am free Saturday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Saturday morning. I'd strongly prefer that you are into Skyforge Arena or Tidewatch, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are into casual matches, but I won't rule you out over it. A small bonus if you are the one who coaches me.
